title: Privacy: the erase tombstones chat history before the record write, so a refused erase has already erased the chat
evidence: Found during S59. deleteAllDataSession (packages/health-core/src/record-session-erase.ts) runs the caller's chat step, steps.chat().eraseAll(), inside beforeErase, before the swap and the flush, the same place the reminders teardown ran before S59. When the record write is then refused and the erase put back (S57), or the erase is refused before the swap (a failed build of the erased file), the record stays but its chat history is already tombstoned. The same ordering issue as S59; needs a design note first (what the tombstones can be read from once the erase stands, and whether a chat step that follows the write leaves a window where another tab reads the old chat). US-11 AC2, AC3
